options.label: Enable
options.description: Off: the key and button do nothing, and gravity returns to normal.

options.label: Require Gravity Anomaly
options.description: On: shifting needs the Gravity Anomaly ability unlocked in your save.

options.label: Keyboard key
options.description: Tap to shift gravity, hold to reset. The default, Key 161, is Right Shift.

options.label: Controller button
options.description: Tap to shift gravity, hold to reset. Works with Xbox, DualSense and DualShock 4 controllers.

options.label: Hold to reset (ms)
options.description: How long to hold the key or button to return to normal gravity.

options.label: Reach (metres)
options.description: How far ahead and above to look for a surface.

options.label: Snap to world axes
options.description: On: the new up is always a world axis. Off: follows the exact surface, snapping only within the snap angle under Advanced.

options.label: Snap angle (degrees)
options.description: With Snap to world axes off: a surface within this angle of a world axis still snaps to it. 0 = never.

options.label: Ray thickness (cm)
options.description: Radius of the sweep that looks for a surface.

options.label: Edge probe: ahead (cm)
options.description: With nothing ahead or above, how far past the edge in front to look for a surface to land on.

options.label: Edge probe: depth (cm)
options.description: How far below floor level the edge probe reaches.

options.label: Edge probe: floor tolerance (cm)
options.description: Ground this close to your own floor level counts as the floor continuing, not as an edge.

options.label: Game version warning
options.description: Warns at start when the game version differs from the one this mod was made for.
